title: Remaining integration module backlog
purpose: Keep frames 05 through 10 available as future bounded admin contract modules without expanding runtime scope.
scope_boundary: Backlog planning for admin contract states only; no conditional display runtime, URL routing runtime, target detector runtime, mobile panel runtime, WooCommerce adapter, or Simple Budget bridge behavior.
entry_condition: TASK-009 snapshot/export is complete and the four named Integrations subplans have explicit boundaries.
exit_condition: Frames 05 through 10 are either mapped to future admin-only tasks or explicitly deferred with stop conditions.
allowed_expansion: Create future admin-only tasks for frames 05 through 10.
Create visual QA tests for each frame before implementation.
Record runtime adapter decisions as deferred.
forbidden_expansion: Build Mobile Responsive Filter Panel runtime.
